title: streaming: improve lifecycle controls for client cancel, disconnect/reconnect resume, and server timeouts (openai-compat)
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds comprehensive streaming lifecycle controls: server-side idle and generation timeouts, explicit handling for client cancel (HTTP/2 GOAWAY and connection close), improved disconnect detection, a resume/reconnect flow using short-lived resume tokens and offsets, and OpenAI-compatible SSE framing for function-calling/structured-output streams. Motivation: production customers observed request leakage and long-running generators when clients disconnect or timeout. This PR unifies behavior across our hosted and private runtimes and keeps OpenAI compatibility for SDKs that expect SSE-formatted events. Includes unit and integration tests, SDK compatibility shims, and migration notes for operators. Rollout plan: gradual rollout behind feature flag with canary traffic, observability added for resume/failure rates, and automated fallback to full-response generation on resume failures. Revert plan: disable feature flag and revert the runtime gating commit if any regression is observed.

review_comments: Arjun: Overall looks good. Two nits: make the default idle timeout conservative (30s) and add a metric for aborted-by-client vs aborted-by-server.
Maya: Adjusted default to 30s and added metrics 'stream.abort.client' and 'stream.abort.server' in observability change.
Sofia: Can we add a short-lived resume token TTL enforcement and a warning in logs when resume fails due to expiry?
Maya: Added TTL enforcement (configurable) and an INFO log when a resume token is invalid/expired. Also added an option to surface resume failure in the API response for debugging behind a flag.
Liam: Integration tests flaky on windows containers — re-ran CI and added a retry in the test harness for flaky teardown.
release_notes: Server: add configurable idle and generation timeouts for streaming; add resume/reconnect flow using resume tokens; client-cancel detection improvements; OpenAI-compatible SSE framing for function calls. SDKs: minor streaming client updates for resume support. Operators: enable streaming_lifecycle_v2 feature flag to opt-in and monitor streaming_resume metrics.
testing_and_deployment: Unit tests added for connection watcher and resume logic; end-to-end integration tests simulate client disconnects and resume. Canary rollout for 1% traffic for 24h, then 10% for 48h, then full rollout. Feature flag 'streaming_lifecycle_v2' controls behavior. Observability added: stream.abort.client, stream.abort.server, stream.resume.success, stream.resume.failure, stream.resume.latency.
upgrade_notes: Operators should enable 'streaming_lifecycle_v2' behind canary; if using private installer, ensure configs/feature_flags/streaming_lifecycle_v2.yaml is applied. Monitor stream.resume.failure and abort metrics during rollout. Resume tokens are short-lived by default (configurable via 'stream.resume.ttl').
backwards_compatibility: OpenAI SSE compatibility preserved by default; SDK clients that do not support resume will receive a full final event on reconnect failure. No breaking changes to public REST endpoints.
notes: This PR consolidates prior ad-hoc fixes for disconnects across hosted and private runtime; future follow-ups include batching resume attempts and exposing a per-request resume_id in response headers for easier debugging.
